visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1’s mid-lesson binary-search state correctly highlights the narrowed range and selected index 8/value 56, whereas Lesson 2, despite a good title screen, shows a contradictory midpoint calculation with low/high still visually placed at the array ends instead of at index 7.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 2 has a well-formed, wired quiz gate after act_found with a real question, plausible options, and a marked correct answer, while Lesson 1 provides no gate specs or plan at all, so it has no functional interactivity.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 2 has more natural, well-segmented narration with clear pacing and spoken math, while Lesson 1 is understandable but reads as one dense continuous monologue with slightly clunkier phrasing like “Big O of Log N.”

sync.rationale: Lesson 2 has several timing issues with cues firing early or late relative to the narration, but it at least provides visual cues that often roughly track the spoken references, whereas Lesson 1 provides no beat/cue timing at all despite narration repeatedly describing visual changes, making synchronization essentially unverifiable and likely absent.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 1 gives a fully accurate, explicit step-by-step trace and clear halving-to-logarithm explanation, while Lesson 2 is mostly correct but has weaker narration around the second comparison/discard and an inconsistency in the plan claiming linear search would take 7 steps instead of 8.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 has a coherent centered title screen and consistent dark styling, while Lesson 1’s opening is essentially a blank off-center white canvas with only a logo, despite Lesson 1 having a cleaner and more legible mid-lesson diagram than Lesson 2’s left-heavy mid-frame with some cramped/overlapping text.

aggregator.explanation: Lesson 2 wins overall with four of six dimensions, including very high-confidence wins in interactivity, synchronization, narration quality, and polish. Its strongest advantage is functional interactivity: it includes a well-formed quiz gate, whereas Lesson 1 has no gate plan. Lesson 2 also has more natural narration and better overall presentation, and although its synchronization has timing flaws, it at least provides cues, unlike Lesson 1. Lesson 1 does win visual accuracy and concept accuracy with solid confidence, especially for its clearer binary-search trace and more accurate explanation, but these two strengths are outweighed by Lesson 2’s broader advantages across more dimensions and higher-confidence votes.
